# ============================================================================
# ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW
# ============================================================================

Description:
Dots & Coms is a full-service digital agency based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India, serving the Indian domestic market with responsive website design, mobile app development (Android & iOS), web hosting infrastructure (shared, VPS, dedicated, cloud), SSL/digital security, and SEO/PPC digital marketing services.

The India-focused (.in) site emphasizes hosting and infrastructure services — including VPS, dedicated servers, and SSL certificates — alongside website design, app development, and search marketing, serving businesses that want a single India-based vendor for build, host, and grow.

For international clients and a broader global service range (including graphic design and domain registration), see the company's global site at dotsandcoms.com.
